feedback.Isolate Host: CRITICAL ENTERPRISE RESCUE: SRV-FILE-PRIMARY isolated immediately via EDR! The combination of vssadmin shadow deletion, PsExec remote service deployment (Event 7045), and SMB2 tree connects to ADMIN$ signaled an active ransomware deployment. Isolating the server halted the encryption engine at 2% completion and severed the lateral infection vector across subnet 10.0.2.0/24.
feedback.Block IP: INEFFECTIVE REMEDIATION: You attempted a border firewall IP block, but this attack is internal-to-internal SMB lateral movement across subnet 10.0.2.0/24! Perimeter border firewalls do not inspect intra-VLAN Layer 2/3 traffic. The encryption continued unimpeded.
feedback.Escalate: ACCEPTABLE: Escalated to Emergency Enterprise CSIRT. In an active ransomware outbreak with 185 renames/second, immediate host isolation is the only measure that prevents total disk encryption, but escalating triggered enterprise containment.
feedback.Dismiss: CATASTROPHIC ENTERPRISE WIPEOUT: Dismissed active LockBit ransomware outbreak! The entire enterprise primary file storage and disaster backups were encrypted and destroyed within 6 minutes.

educational_rationale.topic: Ransomware Precursors, SMB Lateral Movement (Port 445) & Shadow Copy Deletion
educational_rationale.certification_relevance: Security+ SY0-701 (Section 2.4 Lateral Movement & Pivoting, Section 4.3 Endpoint Containment) & Network+ (Section 4.1 SMB Port 445 vs NetBIOS Port 139, Section 1.5 VLAN Segmentation)
educational_rationale.deep_dive: Modern ransomware operators follow a predictable execution playbook prior to file encryption: (1) Inhibit System Recovery: Windows Volume Shadow Copies store snapshot backups. Attackers execute 'vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet' and 'wbadmin.exe DELETE SYSTEMSTATEBACKUP' so the victim cannot revert files using Windows Restore Points; (2) Lateral Spread via SMB: Attackers use compromised administrative credentials to push services across SMB (Port 445) to administrative shares (ADMIN$, C$) using PsExec or WMI (Windows Event ID 7045 - Service Installed, Event ID 5145 - Share Checked); (3) Why Blocking IP Fails: Perimeter border firewalls only police WAN boundary traffic; they do not filter intra-subnet switch traffic. Only EDR Host Isolation can sever local Layer 2/3 network adapters and halt local file encryption.
